nodes.description: Structural modelling and the known crystal contacts of the ETS domain predict that p.(Tyr89Cys) reduces the affinity of ERF for its DNA targets. An equivalent substitution in the nematode orthologue LIN-1 impairs DNA binding and upregulates RAS-MAPK-dependent development. No experiment has measured DNA binding, transcriptional repression, or ERK interaction of the human Tyr89Cys protein, and why this change does not reproduce the craniosynostosis caused by ERF haploinsufficiency is unexplained.
